decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a variety of counter spells, removal spells, and card draw effects to disrupt your opponent's strategy while also building your own resources. Atraxa, Grand Unifier serves as the commander to provide additional support and options for controlling the battlefield. The deck includes a mix of versatile spells such as Counterspell, Cryptic Command, and Demonic Tutor, along with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, Wielder of Mysteries. The mana base is well-tuned to support a range of powerful spells in multiple colors, ensuring that you can consistently cast your control spells and dominate the game.

This deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the commander to control the game by utilizing a wide range of spells, creatures, and lands. The deck is designed to have a versatile and powerful response to any situation, with cards like Demonic Tutor and Worldly Tutor to search for specific answers, along with a mix of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Supreme Verdict. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Ashen Rider and Archon of Cruelty, as well as efficient mana accelerants like Arcane Signet and fetch lands such as Scalding Tarn and Verdant Catacombs. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to have a diverse toolkit to outmaneuver opponents and gain control of the game.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with a variety of creatures and spells, while also disrupting their strategy with hand disruption cards. The commander, Deadpool, Trading Card, provides a powerful aggro engine that can quickly close out games. The deck includes a mix of efficient removal spells, disruptive cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, and powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Dragon's Rage Channeler. With a low curve and plenty of ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, taking advantage of its aggressive strategy to claim victory in the 1 vs 1 format.

This aggressive deck utilizes the partner commanders Ellie, Brick Master and Ellie, Vengeful Hunter to overwhelm opponents with a mix of creatures and powerful spells. The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Bloodsoaked Champion, Carrion Feeder, and Gravecrawler to apply early pressure. It also includes removal spells like Fatal Push, Dismember, and Pyrokinesis to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is efficiently built with fetch lands like Arid Mesa and Polluted Delta, along with dual lands like Badlands and Blood Crypt. With a mix of graveyard recursion, card advantage, and efficient beaters, this deck aims to quickly close out games before opponents can stabilize.
